title: Every update breaks something
body:
It has been more than a year since To-Do was released to replace Wunderlist. Back then I immediately switched to To-Do from Wunderlist, and since then there always is something broken in the app. There are times when the tasks I add simply disappear. Only later do I realize that I haven’t done something I was supposed to do, because it had disappeared from the list. Then there are syncing problems. Even after this update has introduced background syncing, there are still problems with syncing. Not to mention the double appearance of some tasks.

I use To-Do mainly because it is simple and cross platform, and because of the My Day feature, but after using it for a year I have realized that the app isn’t getting any better. Every update seems to break something that was already fixed in the previous updates.

Now I am thinking of trying another app or return to the stock Reminders app in iOS.
